senses.gloss: m. (contr. of בי דייני) prop. court-house, in gen. government’s building, public building, treasury.
units: Ber. 56ᵃ ב׳ דמלכא וכ׳ ed. (Mss. בֵּי זְיוּנָא, בִּזְיוּנָא q. v.) the king’s treasury shall be broken into. [Perl. Et. St. p. 25 refers to Pers. divân which, however, seems of too late an origin for the Talmudic date, v. Cycl. Brit. 9ᵗʰ ed. s. v. Divan.]
